## EqualizationCalculator

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Ledger.EqualizationCalculator</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Ledger/EqualizationCalculator.cs:30](../../../../src/Meridian.Ledger/EqualizationCalculator.cs#L30).

Computes the single-NAV equalisation adjustment for a subscription. When the dealing NAV per unit is above the class high-water mark, existing holders have already borne performance fee on the appreciation, so the new subscriber receives an equalisation credit (perfRate x (nav - highWater) per unit) they recover later. When the dealing NAV is below the high-water mark, the subscriber would ride the recovery fee-free, so a contingent redemption (perfRate x (highWater - nav) per unit) is tracked and collected as the NAV recovers. Pure and deterministic.

## EuropeanDistributionWaterfall

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Ledger.EuropeanDistributionWaterfall</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Ledger/EuropeanDistributionWaterfall.cs:106](../../../../src/Meridian.Ledger/EuropeanDistributionWaterfall.cs#L106).

Runs a European (whole-fund) distribution waterfall with automatic preferred-return and GP catch-up solving: return of capital, then preferred return, then a GP catch-up computed to bring the GP to its carry share of profit, then the carried-interest split. Pure and deterministic — callers no longer pre-compute the pref or catch-up amounts.

## FundAdministrationEventLog

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Ledger.FundAdministrationEventLog</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Ledger/FundAdministrationEventLog.cs:43](../../../../src/Meridian.Ledger/FundAdministrationEventLog.cs#L43).

In-memory, append-only, tamper-evident log of fund-administration governance events. Each appended event is chained to the previous one by SHA-256 hash (FundAdministrationEvent.PreviousHash → FundAdministrationEvent.Hash), so any retroactive edit, reorder, insertion, or deletion is detectable by VerifyIntegrity. The log offers no mutation or removal API; corrections are made by appending compensating events.

## FundEconomicsJournalFactory

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Ledger.FundEconomicsJournalFactory</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Ledger/FundEconomicsJournalFactory.cs:32](../../../../src/Meridian.Ledger/FundEconomicsJournalFactory.cs#L32).

Builds governed AutomatedJournalDrafts for fund fee, expense, and distribution economics so the fund-economics kernels post real ledger entries instead of living only in tests. The fee/expense amounts come from the F# FundEconomics kernels (via FSharpLedger.LedgerInterop); distribution splits come from EuropeanDistributionWaterfall. Every draft is balanced (debits equal credits) and flows through the standard AutomatedJournalApproval submit → approve → post lifecycle before it reaches the governed append boundary.

```csharp
public static class FundEconomicsJournalFactory
```

Declared public members:

| Declaration | Source | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code>public static AutomatedJournalDraft BuildManagementFeeAccrualDraft(string fundId, decimal netAssets, decimal annualRate, int accrualDays, int yearBasisDays, DateOnly effectiveDate, DateTimeOffset occurredAtUtc, string periodId, IReadOnlyList&lt;JournalEvidenceReference&gt;? evidenceReferences = null);</code> | [src/Meridian.Ledger/FundEconomicsJournalFactory.cs:38](../../../../src/Meridian.Ledger/FundEconomicsJournalFactory.cs#L38) | Drafts a day-weighted management-fee accrual: debit management fee expense, credit management fee payable. The amount is computed by the F# management-fee kernel. |
| <code>public static PerformanceFeeAccrualDraftResult BuildPerformanceFeeAccrualDraft(string fundId, decimal endingNavBeforeFee, decimal priorHighWaterMark, decimal hurdleAmount, decimal performanceFeeRate, bool crystallize, DateOnly effectiveDate, DateTimeOffset occurredAtUtc, string periodId, IReadOnlyList&lt;JournalEvidenceReference&gt;? evidenceReferences = null, decimal alreadyAccrued = 0m);</code> | [src/Meridian.Ledger/FundEconomicsJournalFactory.cs:91](../../../../src/Meridian.Ledger/FundEconomicsJournalFactory.cs#L91) | Drafts a performance-fee accrual against the high-water mark, net of a hurdle: debit performance fee expense, credit performance fee payable. Returns the crystallization outputs (including the advanced high-water mark) even when no fee is due, so the caller can persist the mark. The draft is null when the fee is zero. alreadyAccrued is the performance fee already accrued and still payable against the same high-water mark. The draft then books only the change needed to reach the cumulative fee, so accruing every period never books the same gain twice; when the cumulative fee has fallen below what was accrued, the draft reverses the excess. |
| <code>public static AutomatedJournalDraft BuildExpenseAccrualDraft(string fundId, string expenseId, decimal annualAmount, int accrualDays, int yearBasisDays, DateOnly effectiveDate, DateTimeOffset occurredAtUtc, string periodId, IReadOnlyList&lt;JournalEvidenceReference&gt;? evidenceReferences = null);</code> | [src/Meridian.Ledger/FundEconomicsJournalFactory.cs:179](../../../../src/Meridian.Ledger/FundEconomicsJournalFactory.cs#L179) | Drafts a straight-line fund-expense accrual: debit fund operating expense, credit accrued expenses payable. The amount is computed by the F# expense-accrual kernel. |
| <code>public static AutomatedJournalDraft BuildDistributionWaterfallDraft(string fundId, string investorId, EuropeanWaterfallResult waterfall, DateOnly effectiveDate, DateTimeOffset occurredAtUtc, string periodId, string distributionId, IReadOnlyList&lt;JournalEvidenceReference&gt;? evidenceReferences = null);</code> | [src/Meridian.Ledger/FundEconomicsJournalFactory.cs:228](../../../../src/Meridian.Ledger/FundEconomicsJournalFactory.cs#L228) | Drafts a distribution declaration from a European-waterfall result: debit the LP capital account (return of capital plus preferred and carried-interest catch-up) and the GP carried interest allocation, credit the fund distribution payable. Balances by construction because the payable equals the waterfall&#x27;s total distributed amount. |

## IWashSaleReplacementResolver

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Ledger.IWashSaleReplacementResolver</code>. Kind: `interface`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Ledger/IWashSaleReplacementResolver.cs:62](../../../../src/Meridian.Ledger/IWashSaleReplacementResolver.cs#L62).

Resolves the replacement acquisitions a wash-sale evaluation needs. This is the seam that was missing between the relief engine and durable tax-lot history: LedgerTaxLotReliefProjector has always been able to compute a deferral, but only if someone handed it the replacements to match against. Implementations run one indexed query per loss-generating disposal, so the search is scoped by WashSaleReplacementQuery.SecurityId and the policy window rather than scanning lot history.
